top_choice_rationale: P001 credits Katori and Ye for the invention and realization of optical lattice clocks. The magic-wavelength lattice with many-atom Lamb-Dicke interrogation is a distinct step from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. It opened the 10^-18 regime, has been reproduced in several laboratories, and already resolves a gravitational redshift across a millimetre-scale sample. The allocation is the one all eight members converged on, and a citation limited to invention and realization keeps the claim honest about Lemonde, Takamoto and the Sr and Yb groups. Awarding is better than no award, even though B008 and B006 may be larger in pure significance and are not on the slate.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Gross, Rubinstein, Van Riet and the Uppsala theory group are not credited names in P001.
